items.exampleEn: Amy is the most junior person in our office.
items.exampleZh: Amy 是我們辦公室裡資歷最淺的人。

items.exampleEn: We had a party for our company's tenth anniversary.
items.exampleZh: 我們為了公司成立十週年辦了一場派對。

items.exampleEn: We have a big family reunion every Chinese New Year.
items.exampleZh: 我們每年農曆新年都有一場盛大的家族團聚。

items.exampleEn: How many members are there in your family?
Dogs can understand some human words.
items.exampleZh: 狗能聽懂人類說的一些字。

items.exampleEn: A young couple lives next door.
items.exampleZh: 隔壁住著一對年輕夫妻。

items.exampleEn: Tickets are three hundred dollars for adults.
Three generations live in this house.
items.exampleZh: 這間房子裡住著三代人。

items.sentenceEn: This movie is only for adults.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影只限成人觀看。

items.audioEn: Our family reunion is next Sunday at my grandmother's house.
items.audioZh: 我們的家族聚會在下週日，地點是我奶奶家。

items.sentenceEn: She is a junior member of our tennis club.
items.sentenceZh: 她是我們網球社的青少年會員。

items.stemZh: 今天是我們結婚十週年紀念日。

items.stemEn: My grandparents, my parents and I are three different ____.
items.stemZh: 我的祖父母、父母和我是三個不同的世代。

items.passageEn: Last month, the Chen family had a big reunion for the fiftieth anniversary of the grandparents' wedding. Four generations came, from the old couple to two little babies. Every family member brought some food. The adults talked and laughed all afternoon, while the youngest member, a baby girl, slept the whole time.
items.passageZh: 上個月，陳家為了爺爺奶奶結婚五十週年辦了一場大型家族聚會。從那對老夫妻到兩個小寶寶，四代人都來了。每位家族成員都帶了一些食物。大人們整個下午有說有笑，而年紀最小的成員——一個女寶寶——從頭睡到尾。

options: 慶祝爺爺奶奶結婚五十週年

questions.questionZh: 年紀最小的成員在聚會上做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這是人類歷史上很重要的一天。
referenceEn: This is an important day in human history.
This is a very important day in human history.
rubricZh: human 當形容詞放在名詞前（例如 human history）

items.promptZh: 我們班十年後會辦一次同學會。
referenceEn: Our class will have a reunion in ten years.
Our class is going to have a reunion in ten years.
rubricZh: 「同學會」可寫，例如 a reunion、a class reunion 等
未來的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to 等）
「十年後」可寫，例如 in ten years 等
